description: Small white enamel hour plate 180x80 with a postal-red rim, two screw dots and a blank time area the scene letters (10:00, 14:00); sits on the pillar box's collection plate.
Flat ink letter-box key, brass #f2b705 fill with a 3 px ink outline, 160x60.
Ink padlock with a slate #4b4f58 body, 90x120; its #shackle part can show open or closed.
Open-mouthed sand canvas collection bag with an ink drawstring, 260x300, no seal.
The same red pillar letter box, front view, its door swung open to the right with letters stacked inside and a small white barcode label (#barcode) on the inside of the door; 360x420.
A cream wall panel of four small numbered brass-door post boxes (rented lockers), one door ajar with a letter inside; 360x300.
Small wall key cabinet: postal-red frame, glass door, three hooks inside; 240x300.
Round postal-red badge 200x200 with a white letter-box symbol; stands for the letter-box attendant (no person is drawn).
Ink map pin in postal red with a white centre dot, 120x160.
White report sheet 240x300 with three grey relative bars and a small blank table; no numbers.
